_help: Edit only the "text" / "title" / "body" values. "\n" forces a new line.
The game fonts have no accents: they are removed on import (técnico -> tecnico).
Menu texts: at most "max" characters. "original" and "at" identify the text and are not imported.
{1S}{T} and {2N}{D} draw "1ST" and "2ND". Codes like {7a} keep special tiles.
Parts or entries can be removed from the file: missing ones are left unchanged.

scenarios.text:
The Brazilians are down
to ten men and are
struggling against the
U.S. Team. XXX

The Italians are down
to nine players due to
the referee who is
biased towards
Nigeria!

The Spanish are two
goals up and are
strong contenders for
a win but Korea haven't
given up and are
fighting back.

The potent Dutch
offence is up against
a strong defence and
Scotland look likely
to win.

Germany were awarded a
penalty early on
which they converted
but the explosive
Bulgarian strikers are
looking to turn the
tables.

Holland were 0-2 down
but have just struck
back with a great goal
and must win to
qualify for the
Finals.

The key Argentine
striker has just been
sent off for no
apparent reason.
Can they go on to the
Quarter Finals without
him by beating this
great Rumanian side?

The U.S. are winning
2-1.
But the Colombians are
very skilful!
Do your best to stop
them catching up in
the final two minutes.

Bulgaria must win this
game to qualify
whereas the French
only need to draw.
French complacency
could be punished.
